target.title: fix(ios): defer QR pairing after scanner dismissal
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99571.

The iOS QR scanner can crash after scanning a gateway pairing QR because the scanner delegate immediately starts gateway connection/trust UI while VisionKit is still dismissing the scanner and stopping camera capture. On device this aborts in UIKit alert presentation (`UIAlertController _alertControllerContainedInViewController`) with VisionKit concurrently stopping `AVCaptureSession`.

This PR makes onboarding and Settings QR flows stop VisionKit scanning, queue one typed scanner result, dismiss the scanner sheet, then process the result from the sheet `onDismiss` callback after a short main-actor settling delay.

## Evidence

- Reproduced on Polly's iPhone with current-main proof build `2026.6.11 / 488`.
- Crash log: `OpenClaw-2026-07-03-160229.ips`, app bundle `ai.openclawfoundation.app.test.pollybot-5y97h9j837`.
- Crash signature: `EXC_CRASH` / `SIGABRT`, `+[UIAlertController _alertControllerContainedInViewController:]`, with VisionKit stopping `AVCaptureSession` on `com.apple.visionkit.avcapturequeue`.
- Installed local patched build on the same iPhone.
- Scanned a fresh QR through onboarding/Gateway Settings; pairing completed and created an approved iPhone entry from `100.126.168.10`.
- No new QR scanner crash surfaced during the post-scan watch window.
- The physical-iPhone run above predates the final maintainer repair on `93afb17f02e06ccc34bcd65e33a9b088a5e3564b`; fresh exact-head camera proof is still required before merge.

## Implementation

- Stop `DataScannerViewController` in its delegate before requesting dismissal, following VisionKit's documented lifecycle.
- Represent the queued gateway link/setup code as one closed `QRScannerResult` value.
- Dismiss the scanner sheet before starting connection/trust UI.
- Process the queued result after a short main-actor delay.
- Cancel pending scanner continuation work when the view disappears.

## Validation

- `pnpm native:i18n:check`
- `swiftformat --lint --config config/swiftformat apps/ios/Sources/Onboarding/OnboardingWizardView.swift apps/ios/Sources/Design/SettingsProTab.swift apps/ios/Sources/Design/SettingsProTabActions.swift`
- `swiftlint lint --config apps/ios/.swiftlint.yml apps/ios/Sources/Onboarding/OnboardingWizardView.swift apps/ios/Sources/Design/SettingsProTab.swift apps/ios/Sources/Design/SettingsProTabActions.swift`
- `git diff --check`
- Simulator compile: `xcodebuild -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath build/DerivedData-qrscanner-sim build`
- Maintainer exact-head simulator proof: 35 `RootTabsSourceGuardTests` passed on iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5, including callback-order guards for both scanner owners and stop-before-delivery.
- Maintainer autoreview: clean after one accepted test-specificity finding was repaired.
